unit_cn: Unit 1 Science and Scientists 科学与科学家
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 1 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、科学与科学家主题(约翰·斯诺攻克霍乱/科学方法/著名科学家/科学探究精神)、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.meaning_cn: 抽象的;理论上的;(文献的)摘要
words.example_en: After his illness, Hawking's world became one of abstract thought.
words.example_cn: 生病之后,霍金的世界变成了一个充满抽象思维的世界。

words.example_en: Qian worked as a graduate assistant and helped with rocket research.
words.example_cn: 钱学森做过研究生助理,协助进行火箭研究。

words.example_en: Hawking was a brilliant scientist who changed how we see the universe.
words.example_cn: 霍金是一位聪颖的科学家,改变了我们看待宇宙的方式。

words.example_en: When you stand in the light, your body casts a shadow on the wall.
words.example_cn: 当你站在光下时,你的身体会在墙上投下影子。

words.example_en: Scientists use a microscope to study the cells of living things.
words.example_cn: 科学家用显微镜研究生物的细胞。

words.example_en: John Snow discovered how cholera spreads through dirty water.
words.example_cn: 约翰·斯诺发现了霍乱是如何通过脏水传播的。

words.example_en: The steady state theory is a difficult scientific concept to explain.
words.example_cn: 稳态理论是一个很难解释的科学概念。

words.example_en: A good scientist looks for concrete evidence before drawing conclusions.
words.example_cn: 优秀的科学家在得出结论前会寻找确实的证据。

words.meaning_cn: 相互矛盾的;对立的;不一致的
words.example_en: When the data seemed contradictory, the scientists ran the test again.
words.example_cn: 当数据看起来相互矛盾时,科学家们又做了一次实验。

words.example_en: After Snow's work, the number of cholera cases began to decrease.
words.example_cn: 在斯诺的努力之后,霍乱病例的数量开始减少。

words.example_en: Qian believed China needed a strong air force to defend the country.
words.example_cn: 钱学森认为中国需要一支强大的空军来保卫国家。

words.example_en: Cholera can cause serious dehydration if it is not treated quickly.
words.example_cn: 霍乱如果不及时治疗,会引起严重的脱水。

words.example_en: Above all, Hawking was willing to admit his own faults.
words.example_cn: 最重要的是,霍金愿意承认自己的过错。

words.example_en: Snow's main finding was that cholera came from infected water.
words.example_cn: 斯诺最主要的发现是霍乱来自被污染的水。

words.example_en: Every good study needs a clear theoretical framework to guide it.
words.example_cn: 每一项好的研究都需要一个清晰的理论框架来指导。

words.example_en: The team felt frustrated when their first experiments all failed.
words.example_cn: 当最初的实验全部失败时,团队感到很沮丧。

words.example_en: Hawking was brave; furthermore, he was quite determined.
words.example_cn: 霍金很勇敢;此外,他还相当有决心。

words.example_en: People once believed that cholera was caused by germs in the air.
words.example_cn: 人们曾经认为霍乱是由空气中的病菌引起的。

words.example_en: Hawking was one of the most gifted scientists in physics.
words.example_cn: 霍金是物理学界最有天赋的科学家之一。

words.example_en: Snow had the handle of the water pump removed to stop the disease.
words.example_cn: 斯诺让人卸下水泵的把手以阻止疾病传播。

words.meaning_cn: 一家人;家庭;家喻户晓的
words.example_en: Through his discoveries, Snow became a household name in science.
words.example_cn: 凭借自己的发现,斯诺成了科学界家喻户晓的名字。

words.example_en: Waste had infected the water from the Broad Street pump.
words.example_cn: 废物污染了布罗德街水泵里的水。

words.example_en: Clean water can stop the spread of dangerous infection.
words.example_cn: 干净的水能阻止危险的感染传播。

words.example_en: Many problems appeared at the initial stage of the research.
words.example_cn: 在研究的最初阶段出现了许多问题。

words.example_en: Snow's intervention helped to save thousands of lives.
words.example_cn: 斯诺的干预帮助挽救了成千上万的生命。

words.example_en: Under Qian's leadership, China developed its own rockets.
words.example_cn: 在钱学森的领导下,中国研制出了自己的火箭。

words.example_en: Snow showed a clear link between dirty water and cholera.
words.example_cn: 斯诺揭示了脏水与霍乱之间的明确联系。

words.example_en: Qian first studied railway mechanical engineering at university.
words.example_cn: 钱学森在大学最初学的是铁路机械工程。

words.example_en: Surprisingly, Snow did not use a microscope to defeat cholera.
words.example_cn: 令人惊讶的是,斯诺并没有用显微镜来攻克霍乱。

words.example_en: Qian was put in charge of China's rocket and missile programme.
words.example_cn: 钱学森负责中国的火箭和导弹计划。

words.example_en: Cold-causing viruses come in multiple kinds and change quickly.
words.example_cn: 引起感冒的病毒种类繁多,而且变化迅速。

words.example_en: His curiosity helped make him such an outstanding scientist.
words.example_cn: 他的好奇心使他成为如此杰出的科学家。

words.example_en: Qian was a patriotic scientist who served his homeland.
words.example_cn: 钱学森是一位爱国的科学家,他报效祖国。

words.example_en: You can pour the strange fluid like water until you press on it.
words.example_cn: 在你按压之前,你可以像倒水一样倒出这种奇怪的液体。

words.example_en: Scientists need solid proof before they accept a new idea.
words.example_cn: 科学家在接受新观点前需要确凿的证据。

words.example_en: The new medicine blocks a key protein inside the body's cells.
words.example_cn: 这种新药能阻断人体细胞内的一种关键蛋白质。

words.example_en: People who drank pure water were far less likely to get cholera.
words.example_cn: 喝干净水的人得霍乱的可能性要小得多。

words.example_en: In the museum, light casts your shadow in the colours of the rainbow.
words.example_cn: 在博物馆里,光会把你的影子投成彩虹的颜色。

words.example_en: Some companies sold water that was polluted by raw waste.
words.example_cn: 有些公司出售被未经处理的废物污染的水。

words.example_en: Cholera was once a severe disease that killed many people.
words.example_cn: 霍乱曾是一种夺去许多人生命的严重疾病。

words.example_en: The light at the science museum can cast many shadows of you.
words.example_cn: 科学博物馆的灯光能投出你的许多影子。

words.example_en: Qian's change of major was not just a shift in personal interest.
words.example_cn: 钱学森改变专业并不只是个人兴趣的转变。

words.meaning_cn: 坚实的;可靠的;固体的;固体
words.example_en: It was time to calm down and do some solid work.
words.example_cn: 是时候冷静下来,做些扎实的工作了。

words.example_en: The steady state theory holds that the universe has no beginning.
words.example_cn: 稳态理论认为宇宙没有起点。

words.example_en: His work led to a substantial decrease in the threat of cholera.
words.example_cn: 他的工作使霍乱的威胁大幅下降。

words.example_en: Snow began to suspect that the water was carrying the disease.
words.example_cn: 斯诺开始怀疑是水在传播这种疾病。

words.example_en: Astronomers with telescopes soon proved Hawking's theory.
words.example_cn: 使用望远镜的天文学家很快证明了霍金的理论。

words.example_en: Much of the rocket technology can be traced back to Qian's research.
words.example_cn: 许多火箭技术都可以追溯到钱学森的研究。

words.example_en: Snow transformed the way scientists study diseases.
words.example_cn: 斯诺改变了科学家研究疾病的方式。

words.example_en: The group worked hard to develop a vaccine for malaria.
words.example_cn: 这个团队努力研发疟疾疫苗。

words.example_en: It is tricky to target a cold-causing virus directly.
words.example_cn: 直接针对引起感冒的病毒是很棘手的。

words.example_en: Scientists must have a vivid imagination to make new discoveries.
words.example_cn: 科学家必须有生动的想象力才能做出新发现。
